# Descript

> > Descript is an AI-powered video and audio editing platform featuring Underlord AI for transcription, translation, content generation, and multimedia editing.

Descript provides collaborative editing tools for podcasters, video creators, and content teams. The platform combines text-based editing with AI capabilities including automated transcription in 20+ languages, AI voice cloning, video clip generation, and multilingual dubbing for global content distribution.

## Key Topics

- Underlord AI
- AI transcription
- Video editing
- Audio editing
- Content creation
- Multilingual translation
- Video captions and subtitles
- Localization
- YouTube content tools
- Instagram and TikTok optimization
- Text-to-speech
- Audio extraction
- Accessibility features
- AI content generation

## AI-Powered Content Creation Tools

- [Generate AI Clips Using Descript's AI](https://www.descript.com/tools/ai-clips-generator): AI-powered video clips generator using Underlord AI for social media
- [AI Hashtag Generator | Instagram & TikTok Hashtags in Seconds](https://www.descript.com/tools/hashtag-generator): AI tool generating Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube hashtags from content
- [Generate Video Idea Using Descript's Online Underlord](https://www.descript.com/tools/video-idea-generator): AI video idea generator using Underlord for multi-platform content
- [Generate YouTube Channel Description Using Descript's Online Underlord](https://www.descript.com/tools/youtube-channel-description-generator): AI-powered YouTube channel description generator using Underlord
- [Generative Video: Stylized Background Loops in Descript](https://www.descript.com/tools/generative-video-stylized-background-loops): Create AI-driven looping backgrounds with generative video technology

- [Extract Audio from YouTube Video | Free Tool | Descript](https://www.descript.com/tools/extract-audio-from-youtube-video): Extract audio from YouTube videos to MP3 or WAV format for free
- [Remove Audio From Youtube Video For Free Online](https://www.descript.com/tools/remove-audio-from-youtube-video): Free tool for removing audio from YouTube videos with Descript
- [Remove Audio From Instagram Reel For Free Online](https://www.descript.com/tools/remove-audio-from-instagram-reel): Free online tool to remove audio from Instagram Reels instantly
